newsitem.title: UK: Euro veg oils trend up, thin trade/little interest.
newsitem.headline: Euro veg oils trend up, thin trade/little interest.

text.p: European vegetable oils trend was firmer at midday in line with gains on both the Malaysian palm oil and Chicago soybean oil futures, traders said.
However, in the absense of any major market moving news, trade was slight and the market was likely to continue moving around in a fairly narrow range.
The palm oil sector at the end of the morning stood $2.50 higher than Tuesday's close. Crude traded Mar and Apr at $550 per tonne and Jul/Sep fetched $542.50.
Other palm oil business included RBD, which traded from Apr at $539 to Jul $527.50, and Olein which traded May at $569 and $567.50.
The softs oils at midday were tradeless but firmer by 0.50 to 1.50 guilders.
The lauric oils were $2.50 higher to $7.50 lower. Palmkernel oil traded at $700 for July and Jul/Aug and Apr/May at $707.50.
